title: Reminder campaigns, the call list and the shared ledger (job CP)
description: Generated from services/ai-api/app/{campaigns,dues}/models.py by `make contracts`. Requests forbid unknown properties: a status, an approver, a sender, a rendered text or an amount a model made can never be sent.

ApproveIn.description: The hash of the samples the Owner SAW: if the campaign changed since, the approval is refused (409 `samples_changed`).
ApproveIn.title: ApproveIn

CallItemOut.description: One person to call. The number is never shown: the call goes through the bridge (`call_request_id` is the approved request to start it with).
CallItemOut.title: CallItemOut

CampaignDetailOut.description: One campaign, with what still stands between a draft and its approval (closed words, each with a fixed sentence in `issue_text`) and whether the worker may send (both switches on).
CampaignDetailOut.title: CampaignDetailOut

CampaignIn.description: The whole campaign (a PUT: the same id again changes it). The kind never changes. A change to a campaign that was approved sends it back to draft.
CampaignIn.title: CampaignIn

ChargesImportIn.description: A fee list or an accounting export, already read into rows (at most 5,000). `batch_id` is the caller's: the same file sent again adds nothing.
ChargesImportIn.title: ChargesImportIn

EntryIn.description:
One entry. A CHARGE has a due date (and may carry the owner's invoice number or a short label such as a fee head); a PAYMENT names its method; an ADJUSTMENT says debit or credit and why; a CONCESSION says
why. Adjustments and concessions are the Owner's or Admin's, with a second factor (the database decides). The amount is a number someone entered.
EntryIn.title: EntryIn

LedgerFilterIn.description: The ledger list: every party with money open on claims due between `due_from` and `due_to` (at most 400 days), optionally only companies, contacts or education students (a guardian's students are ONE person: one message with the total), optionally only at least `min_open_paise`.
LedgerFilterIn.title: LedgerFilterIn

OutcomeIn.description: What happened on the call: `paid`, `promised` (with a date from today to 60 days), `call_later` (with a time within 30 days), `wrong_number` or `stop` (the person is put on the do-not-contact list).
OutcomeIn.title: OutcomeIn

PreviewOut.description:
What the Owner sees before approving: the count, the total, the dates, the rendered samples (the first, the longest, the highest amount and three at random) and the hash of what was shown. The first message
to a person also carries `disclosure`.
PreviewOut.title: PreviewOut

ReceiptOut.description: A receipt, ready to print or to send: the number, the date, the amount, the method, who paid, what it was set against and the balance after it.
ReceiptOut.title: ReceiptOut

RecipientRowIn.description:
One person by contact id or by phone number (the number only FINDS an existing contact of this business; it is not stored), with the date the reminder is about, an amount for a money reminder and a short
label (an invoice number, a fee head) when the text uses one.
RecipientRowIn.title: RecipientRowIn

ResultsOut.description: Counts derived from the outbox and the WhatsApp status table. States: planned, skipped (a reason), held (waiting for a person), waiting (queued), sent, delivered, read, failed, blocked (a reason).
ResultsOut.title: ResultsOut

StepIn.description: One step: `offset_days` from the person's own date (negative is before, 0 the day itself) and the time of day, India time, as HH:MM. At most five steps, in order.
StepIn.title: StepIn
